evidence.correction_note: S180-6B Task-1 (session 181) claimed atlas_packets and codebase_chunk_index did not exist. Both claims are FALSE. That audit queried the Drizzle schema file only, never live Postgres, or was run against a different connection context. All conclusions dependent on 'atlas_packets is absent' are invalidated.
atlas_packets_constraints: NOT NULL: packet_id, embedding_eligible, permissions, topology, vectors, workspace_revision, representation_revision
no FK constraints found on tree_node_id, symbol_id, chunk_id

atlas_packets_coverage.workspace_id_semantics: directory-path-like string (e.g. 'docs', 'sveltekit-frontend', 'src/lib/server'), NOT a tenant/workspace id, NOT the 'unknown' default in top values

chunk_id_join_test.conclusion: atlas_packets.chunk_id values are self-generated/orphan UUIDs -- do NOT reference codebase_chunk_index.id or .chunk_id under any tested join key

source_ref_join_test.conclusion: real, working join path exists via source_ref (not chunk_id/symbol_id)

packet_qdrant_bridge_inspection.conclusion: packet_qdrant_bridge.packet_key is a strict, fully-covered subset of atlas_packets.packet_key. Shape (sync bookkeeping fields only: qdrant_point_id, qdrant_collection, matched_by, confidence, relative_path, timestamps) plus zero FK plus zero content/provenance columns indicates PROJECTION_BRIDGE, not a second canonical source.

migration_tracking.conclusion: Both migration ledgers are empty. atlas_packets' 200+ column live shape (including workspace_revision, representation_revision, som_*, pagerank_*, embedding_eligible, etc.) was NOT applied through either tracked migration path. It was built out-of-band (manual SQL / ALTER scripts / drizzle-kit push without journal commit). ATLAS_PACKETS_MIGRATION cannot be classified APPLIED or UNAPPLIED -- classified UNKNOWN.

sample_readers_writers.field_naming: snake_case, DOES NOT EXIST on Drizzle table object (schema defines packetKey)

sample_readers_writers.usage: UPDATE .set({ repository_id, directory_id, file_id, module_id, symbol_id, feature_id, chunk_id, ... }).where(eq(atlasPackets.packet_key, ...))
sample_readers_writers.field_naming: snake_case .set() keys + snake_case .where() field, both mismatched vs camelCase schema

sample_readers_writers.classification: re-export only, single source of truth confirmed (no duplicate table definitions under same export name)

active_code_consumers.conclusion: atlas_packets is heavily, actively wired (ace/, retrieval/, workers/, mcp/, routes/api/, tests/) -- this is NOT dead code or a stale table. But at least one live writer (identity-worker.ts) has a field-naming bug (snake_case vs camelCase) that would fail at the Drizzle query-builder level for any row matching, since eq(atlasPackets.packet_key, ...) resolves to eq(undefined, ...).
